title: Add reflex-webmcp package with WebMCPPlugin
author: FarhanAliRaza

unresolved.first_comment: P1 Registrations outlive their routes: when client-side navigation unmounts a route-specific component tree, its tool remains in the document-global registry with an executable closure (reflex_webmcp/__init__.py:389-393).

P1 Qualified state names collide: when different modules define State classes and handlers with the same names, `_tool_name` collapses them into one global tool name and the second registration is suppressed (__init__.py:369).
P2: The new workspace package `reflex-webmcp` was added, but `reflex_webmcp` was not added to `[tool.coverage.run] source` in pyproject.toml, so its tests will not be measured against the 72% gate.

P2: When two state classes in different modules share a class and handler name, this generates the same WebMCP name and the global deduplication set skips the second tool (__init__.py:369). Use a sanitized qualified state name.

P2: When a route component is unmounted, this registration remains in `document.modelContext` because it passes no `AbortSignal` (__init__.py:393). Register each tool with a route-scoped signal and abort on cleanup.
P3: The docs example (docs/api-reference/plugins.md:88) calls `search_products(query, limit=limit)` but never defines or imports it, so copying the snippet raises NameError.

P1 Include the full state identity in tool names: two page modules defining the same class/handler names both reduce to `reflex_State_submit`; derive the tool name from the qualified state/event identity (__init__.py:369).

P1 Scope registered tools to the active route: top-level `document.modelContext` registrations are never removed on client-side navigation; register/unregister with the route lifecycle (__init__.py:389-393).
P2 Unwrap TypedDict field requirement annotations: `Required[T]`/`NotRequired[T]` fall through to `{}` so the field type is lost in the generated schema (__init__.py:159-160).
